name: ZCA_OML_JOBS
description: This table stores the user defined Job Details.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table.

columns.name: USECASE_CODE
columns.description: This column is the foreign key to ZCA_OML_USECASE.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: This table contains the User Enterable Job Name.

columns.name: JOB_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column contains description of the Job or Model.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column contains the status flag of the job run for model creation.Default value is Draft.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: This table contains the Job Schedule information.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_METADATA
columns.description: This column stores any extra information regarding the scheduled job.

columns.name: CRITERIA_FILTER_EXPR
columns.description: This column is used to store the datasource filter criteria for a model.

columns.name: STORE_PREDICTION
columns.description: This column is used to check if prediction storage is enabled or not.

columns.name: STORE_PRED_VALUE_COL_NAME
columns.description: This column is used to store Custom Field Name which would store the Predicted Value for Regression and Classification.

columns.name: STORE_PRED_PROB_COL_NAME
columns.description: This column is used to store Custom Field Name which would store the Predicttion Probability for Regression and Classification.

columns.name: STORE_PRED_SUCCESS_PROB_COL
columns.description: This column is used to store Custom Field Name which would store the Prediction Success Probability for Regression and Classification. This can be null, it can only have a value if PREFERRED_TARGET_VALUE field has value.

columns.name: STORE_PRED_SCHEDULE
columns.description: This column is used to store the shcedule information when the Prediction Storage Job would run.

columns.name: STORE_PRED_CRITERIA_FILTER
columns.description: This column is used to store the Filter Criteria for Predicted Score storage.

columns.name: DEBUG_MESSAGE_DATA
columns.description: This column is used to store the debug messages for the http rest request for debugging purpose.

columns.name: PREFERRED_ALGORITHM
columns.description: This column stores the preferred algorthm for training the sales machine learning model.

columns.name: MIN_JW_SIMILARITY_SCORE
columns.description: This column stores the minimum jw simialrity score for querying clustering models.

columns.name: MIN_CLUSTER_PROBABILITY
columns.description: This column stores the minimum clustering probability for querying models.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
